problems: The blind guess ('faint blue arcs hugging the gold edges, no clear object') describes this image accurately. Nothing reads as a boat, lantern rope, or sail.
The blue arcs are offset copies of the gold polylines, not a silhouette. They trace the same edges and add no body outline, so the figure is effectively the gold lines drawn twice.

Hull: bow 10602 (~244,379), keel 8241 (~332,420) and stern 7083 (~384,338) form a thin triangle with a flat deck line through 9007 (~305,380). It has no curved bowl or belly, so it doesn't read as a hull.

Sail: the sail is a thin pinched shape between yard 9459 (~291,247), belly 8837 (~316,279) and foot 9095 (~316,279). The belly sits on the mast line rather than bulging out, so there is no sail silhouette.

Lantern rope: 11407 (~208,307), 12413 (~157,218), 12486 (~148,160) and far end 13847 (~84,176) form a zigzag, not a rope with lanterns hanging along it. The rope doesn't meet the mast at the sail foot.
Streamer: masthead lantern 8882 (~317,206) to streamer tip 6867 (~408,230) is a single straight gold line, with no trailing curve.
Labels overlap the drawing and each other ('first lantern on the rope' over the mast line, 'bow of the hull' over 'mast foot', 'keel' label clipped). The image is hard to read.
Orientation: masthead is at the top and keel at the bottom, so the boat is upright. That part is correct.
output.advice: Redraw as a true silhouette, not a gold-line copy. Keep the star positions and draw the body outline through them. (1) Hull: draw a curved bowl from bow 10602 (~244,379) down through keel 8241 (~332,420) and up to stern 7083 (~384,338). Bulge the bottom outward, and close it with a gently curved deck line from stern back to bow passing through mast foot 9007 (~305,380). (2) Mast: a vertical line from 9007 (deck) up to 9459 (yard, top, ~291,247). (3) Sail: a bulging curve from yard 9459 out through the full belly 8837 and back to the mast at 9095 (where the foot meets the rope). The curve should bow outward, away from the mast, so it reads as a sail. (4) Lantern rope: a drooping arc from the mast junction 9095 down-left through 11407 (~208,307), 12413 (~157,218), 12486 (~148,160) to far end 13847 (~84,176). Hang a small lantern glyph at each of the three lantern stars. (5) Masthead lantern 8882 (~317,206) sits at the top of the mast.
